name: The Anchors of Zephras
objectiveText: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.   View the Anchor Pylon  ( 1 )

comments.body: Doesn't work for me. Nothing happens when I talk to the guy. I guess it could be due to some addon, but even if I disable all of them, it doesn't help.
replies: Looks to be a bug with the last patch.
I tried just now with zero addons and it won't work for me either. Appears bugged. It worked on release day though on another character...
Agreed it is not worth it as a level 2 quest if it does work
Also bugged for me, turned off all addons, abandoned and reaccepted the quest. Nothing happens when you select the dialog option.
